changes: Two-layer English-only-artifact enforcement: (1) a warn-only PreToolUse(Bash) hook (.claude/hooks/english-only-guard.cjs, generated via init-assets+managed-assets+cli-init HOOK_FILES) that warns on CJK in git commit / lattice story-metadata commands; (2) a diff/story-scoped english-artifacts CJK gate in the validate REVIEW->TEST preflight (handlers/english-artifact-gate.ts + review-preflight.ts) backed by a pure core/cjk-detect.ts; plus a 7-test smoke including an init-rerun regression test.
usage: Layer 1 warns immediately when an artifact-writing command contains Chinese; Layer 2 hard-fails the validate preflight (blocking REVIEW->TEST) when the current story commits or author-controlled metadata contain CJK, while never flagging legacy files. Run npm run test:english-only-guards-smoke to exercise both.
expectedOutcome: Hook prints an english-only warning on a CJK commit/metadata command (exit 0); validate preflight blocks REVIEW->TEST on CJK in current-story artifacts and passes on English-only.
actualTranscript: Hook demo printed warn english-only: CJK detected ... (exit 0) on a CJK commit command and stayed silent on English; smoke all 7 green; the english-artifacts gate passed in this story own preflight (dogfood); lattice init into a temp dir installs the hook on both fresh init and init-rerun (Test 7).
outcomeDiff: No difference; both layers behave exactly as specified (see evidence/transcript-diff.md).
limitations: Coverage is commits + lattice story metadata only (diff/story-scoped). The broad active-source/doc no-new-Chinese gate is the separate, already-implemented Phase 3 (english-open-source-surface-smoke.ts). Layer 1 is warn-only by design; Codex-host equivalent deferred. CJK ranges cover Han U+4E00-9FFF + Ext A U+3400-4DBF (matches Phase 3).
pitfalls: The hook/gate must be generated via init-assets+managed-assets (not hand-edited); two parallel Claude-hook merge paths exist (cli-init.ts init-rerun + managed-assets.ts) and BOTH need the per-entry fix or the second hook is silently dropped on init-rerun (caught by escalation review). Source files must build CJK ranges from code points so they do not self-trip the gate.
